$comment: Baseline output sizes for the published artifacts. Maintained by scripts/validate-bundle-size.ts. Update via `pnpm tsx scripts/validate-bundle-size.ts --update` when a legitimate size change lands; commit the diff. Sizes are bytes, tolerance ±5% (configurable in the script). NOTE: dist/components.css is intentionally NOT gated here — it is a Tailwind v4 `@source`-scanned generated artifact whose exact byte size is environment-sensitive (the v3/v4 `@import "tailwindcss"` resolution + scan behavior differs across pnpm layouts: ~470KB locally vs ~104KB on CI runners, both valid). Its size + content are bounded by the environment-robust `dogfood:precompiled-utilities` gate (5KB floor / 600KB ceiling + content assertions). Byte-exact ±5% is the wrong tool for a generated CSS scan; this gate stays focused on the deterministic shipped JS/dts bundles.
